0022600133.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers host the Washington Wizards in the Cavaliers' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with Cleveland at 2-1 overall, 2-0 at home, on a two-game winning streak, and 2nd in the Central, 0.5 games back, while sitting 6th in the East. Washington comes in at 2-2, on a one-game losing streak, 3rd in the Southeast and 1 game back, and 9th in the East, and it will be without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Cavaliers won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 130-117 victory in Cleveland on April 12, 2026.
